pages.text: The Wireless Grid in Refined Storage 2 has been significantly enhanced with improved range, better reliability, and enhanced security features. This portable version of the Grid provides full access to your storage network from anywhere within range, now with unified item and fluid management just like the standard Grid.

Key improvements:$(li)Enhanced wireless range$(li)Better connection stability$(li)Improved security features$(li)Unified item/fluid handling$(li)Enhanced power efficiency$(li)Better cross-dimensional support$(br2)RS2's wireless system now provides a more reliable and secure remote access experience.

Setup and Usage:$(li)Craft a Wireless Grid$(li)Create a Network Card$(li)Configure Wireless Transmitter$(li)Link the Grid to your network$(li)Access items anywhere in range$(li)Use dimensional upgrades for extended reach$(br2)The new system features improved power management and better connection handling.
